snippet.title: Foil Boat Brisket Recipe (In Description)
snippet.description:
Recipe:
Servings: 6-8 People
Prep: 60 minutes
Cook: 10-14 hours

Ingredients:
1 Whole Packer Brisket, 13-15 lbs
2 cups Mesquite Peppercorn Lager Rub
1.5 cups Imperial Coffee Stout Rub
1 cup Beef Tallow, warmed up

Instructions:

Keeping your brisket cold, place the brisket on your cutting board fat cap side down. Next, trim the outside of the flat of any silver skin or pockets of fat. Remove the larger pocket of fat near where the flat and point meet. Square off all sides of your brisket then cut one of the corners on the point to show you how to cut against the grain later. Flip the brisket over and begin carefully removing fat from the fat cap. Make sure the fat cap side is about ¼ inch thick as anymore will be too much. Finally, remove most of the fat “flap” at the top of the brisket. Once completely trimmed, season thoroughly with my Mesquite Peppercorn Lager Rub and Imperial Coffee Stout Rub (or your favorite beef rub). Place your brisket into the fridge to dry brine overnight..
Preheat your smoker for 225-250F with some added wood chunks or chips for extra smoke flavor.
Add the brisket on to the smoker fat side up. Cook the brisket until it reaches about 165-170F at the thickest and fattiest part (about 7-8 hours). Once it has hit 165, get ready for the foil boat.
Lay out 1-2 pieces of foil and add beef tallow to the foil. Place the brisket (fat side up) on top of the beef tallow then form the foil around the brisket to make a “boat”.
Place the brisket back onto the smoker at 250F. Cook until the meat hits 201F internal or is probe tender (about 5-6 more hours). Once it is done, pull the meat off and let it rest at room temperature for at least 2 hours but ideally overnight in a warming tray.
When it is ready to slice, unwrap and place the butcher paper to the side (save for serving or for burnt ends). Begin slicing the brisket right where you made your “against the grain” cut when prepping. Make your slices about the width of a #2 Pencil.

localized.title: Foil Boat Brisket Recipe (In Description)
localized.description:
Recipe:
Servings: 6-8 People
Prep: 60 minutes
Cook: 10-14 hours

Ingredients:
1 Whole Packer Brisket, 13-15 lbs
2 cups Mesquite Peppercorn Lager Rub
1.5 cups Imperial Coffee Stout Rub
1 cup Beef Tallow, warmed up

Instructions:

Keeping your brisket cold, place the brisket on your cutting board fat cap side down. Next, trim the outside of the flat of any silver skin or pockets of fat. Remove the larger pocket of fat near where the flat and point meet. Square off all sides of your brisket then cut one of the corners on the point to show you how to cut against the grain later. Flip the brisket over and begin carefully removing fat from the fat cap. Make sure the fat cap side is about ¼ inch thick as anymore will be too much. Finally, remove most of the fat “flap” at the top of the brisket. Once completely trimmed, season thoroughly with my Mesquite Peppercorn Lager Rub and Imperial Coffee Stout Rub (or your favorite beef rub). Place your brisket into the fridge to dry brine overnight..
Preheat your smoker for 225-250F with some added wood chunks or chips for extra smoke flavor.
Add the brisket on to the smoker fat side up. Cook the brisket until it reaches about 165-170F at the thickest and fattiest part (about 7-8 hours). Once it has hit 165, get ready for the foil boat.
Lay out 1-2 pieces of foil and add beef tallow to the foil. Place the brisket (fat side up) on top of the beef tallow then form the foil around the brisket to make a “boat”.
Place the brisket back onto the smoker at 250F. Cook until the meat hits 201F internal or is probe tender (about 5-6 more hours). Once it is done, pull the meat off and let it rest at room temperature for at least 2 hours but ideally overnight in a warming tray.

Seorang raja menghamili Talia saat ia tertidur lelap. Beberapa bulan kemudian, Talia terbangun dengan terkejut karena ternyata ia telah melahirkan anak kembar dalam tidurnya.

Bertahun-tahun kemudian, sang raja teringat kepada Talia. Ia kembali dan menemukan Talia bersama kedua anak mereka. Sang raja menjelaskan bagaimana Talia bisa hamil saat tertidur. Talia pun memaafkannya dan akhirnya jatuh cinta kepadanya.

Sang raja kemudian pulang ke istana, tetapi tingkah lakunya membuat sang ratu curiga. Karena cemburu, sang ratu membawa kedua anak kembar itu ke istana dan memerintahkan juru masak untuk membunuh mereka. Namun, juru masak diam-diam menyelamatkan kedua anak tersebut dan menyajikan daging domba sebagai gantinya.

Sang ratu lalu memanggil Talia dan memerintahkan agar ia dibakar hidup-hidup. Saat Talia berteriak ketakutan, sang raja bergegas datang dan menyelamatkannya. Setelah mengetahui bahwa istrinya berusaha membunuh anak-anaknya, ia menghukum sang ratu dengan membakarnya dalam api yang sama.

Sang raja memberi hadiah kepada juru masak karena telah menyelamatkan anak-anaknya. Akhirnya, ia menikahi Talia dan mereka hidup bahagia selamanya.
